message.text: I recall that useMemoQueries.ts already relies on memoServiceClient.

q17.

web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts; memoServiceClient

This module defines the memo CRUD hooks (`useMemos`, `useMemo`, `useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo`, etc.) and uses the `memoServiceClient` imported from `web/src/connect.ts` to call `listMemos`, `getMemo`, `createMemo`, `updateMemo`, and `deleteMemo`.
